If on a branch other than main, prefix your commit message with the branch name in square brackets, e.g. `[feature-branch] Add new feature`. This helps with tracking which changes belong to which branches, especially when multiple branches are being worked on simultaneously.

When writing the commit message, follow these guidelines:
- Use the imperative mood in the subject line (e.g. "Add", "Fix", "Update")
- Keep the subject line concise (50 characters or less)
- Separate the subject from the body with a blank line
- Use the body to explain what and why vs. how, if necessary BE CONCISE.

Example commit messages:

```[feature-branch] Add user authentication

Add JWT-based authentication to the API.
```

```
Add nx skills
```
